capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 2018 Mid Range (North America): 65 kWh total. 2019 carried over from the 2018 page (same trim).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 2018 Mid Range (North America): 62.5 kWh usable. 2019 carried over from the 2018 page (same trim).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Listed as NCA (Panasonic). 2019 carried over from the 2018 page (same trim).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: evspecifications lists 200 kW DC for the 2018 Mid Range (ArenaEV: 200 kW on Supercharger V3). 2019 carried over from the 2018 page (same trim).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Tesla service manual ties 48 A (11.5 kW) to the Long Range battery and gives 32 A (about 7.7 kW) otherwise; the Mid Range is not the Long Range battery, so the same basis as the other non-LR packs is used. evspecifications lists 11.5 kW for the 2018 Mid Range but its figures for this car (1.44/5.76/9.6/11.5 kW) do not settle the onboard-charger rating. 2019 carried over from the 2018 page (same trim).
